gloss: to slide; to slip; to glide

definitions.gloss: to slide; to slip; to glide
definitions.explanation: To cause something to move smoothly across a surface.

examples.japanese: {手|て}を{滑|すべ}らせて{皿|さら}を{落|お}とした。
examples.english: I let my hand slip and dropped the plate.

examples.japanese: ペンを{紙|かみ}の{上|うえ}を{滑|すべ}らせる。
examples.english: To glide the pen across the paper.

examples.japanese: {指|ゆび}をスクリーンの{上|うえ}で{滑|すべ}らせて{操作|そうさ}する。
examples.english: Operate by sliding your finger across the screen.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). The causative/transitive form of {滑|すべ}る (to slip, slide - intransitive).

VERB PAIR:
・{滑|すべ}る (intransitive) - to slip, slide
・{滑|すべ}らす / {滑|すべ}らせる (transitive) - to slide something, cause to slip

COMMON USES:
・{手|て}を{滑|すべ}らせて〜 - to let one's hand slip and...
・{視線|しせん}を{滑|すべ}らせる - to let one's gaze wander/slide
・ソリを{滑|すべ}らせる - to slide a sled
